summary: Implemented T060 — the V1 strategy layer contracts at src/robinhood_lp/strategy/base.py and the package surface at src/robinhood_lp/strategy/__init__.py, with comprehensive tests in tests/test_strategy_t060.py. The module exposes (1) three immutable, versioned snapshots: AdmissionSnapshot, MarketSnapshot, PortfolioSnapshot (all frozen dataclasses carrying their SNAPSHOT_VERSION constant, unit, data_time, availability_time); (2) two substitutable component interfaces RegimeModel and FeeOpportunityModel (Protocols) with their respective outputs RegimeAssessment and FeeOpportunityAssessment, both carrying an explicit ASSESSED/UNCERTAIN outcome and a state field; the uncertainty path is exercised by RegimeAssessment.uncertain() and FeeOpportunityAssessment.uncertain() convenience constructors; (3) DeterministicClock and SeededRandomSource interfaces plus FrozenClock and FrozenSeededRandomSource reference implementations that are wall-clock-free and unseeded-random-free per ADR-006; (4) validate_proposal which rejects invalid ticks (out of bounds, unaligned, degenerate), stale snapshots (availability_time > decision_time), NaN/display values, and excessive capital — all failures raise a structured exception family (InvalidTickError, StaleSnapshotError, NaNDisplayValueError, InvalidCapitalError, InvalidProposalError) before any CandidateAction is constructed; (5) a ReasonCode StrEnum covering the closed NO_TRADE vocabulary; (6) a CandidateAction frozen dataclass with three closed kinds (NO_TRADE / WAIT / PROPOSE) — PROPOSE carries the Range and capital envelope, WAIT/NO_TRADE carry sentinels; and (7) evaluate_decision which orchestrates validation + component queries into a single CandidateAction. Dependency purity is enforced by assert_strategy_layer_is_pure() which walks the live module graph and rejects any robinhood_lp import outside the strategy + protocol allowlist; a sibling test injects a sentinel robinhood_lp.rpc ModuleType and confirms the helper raises. The two heterogeneous PoolKey fixtures (one native currency with no hook, one ERC-20 with dynamic fee and a hook) exercise the cross-PoolKey acceptance clause. All 80 strategy tests pass; the full project suite (excluding the Foundry-only ABI oracle test that requires v4-core submodules to be installed) reports 1844 passed, 6 skipped; ruff format/check clean; mypy --strict clean on src and tests.

The same test passes in /home/lpdev/lp. This is an environmental gap, not a T060 defect, and the reviewer's detached worktree will resolve it when it runs there.

Strategy components currently return ASSESSED outcomes on every code path the tests exercise; a production rule implementation (T062 / T065) and a future model-backed implementation (T102) are out of scope for T060 — T060 only defines the contracts.

evaluate_decision implements a single, conservative default policy (RANGE + positive fee edge -> PROPOSE; ASSESSED-but-not-RANGE or zero fee -> WAIT; UNCERTAIN -> NO_TRADE). The candidate policy and the binding economic gate live in T065 / T066 and are explicitly out of scope for T060.

FrozenClock and FrozenSeededRandomSource are reference implementations; production wires the orchestration layer's deterministic clock and seeded random source into the strategy contract via Protocol injection. The interface is the contract; the reference implementations exist to make the contract testable.

The strategy layer adds a new robinhood_lp subpackage; nothing else in the repo currently imports from it (verified by collect_strategy_module_imports). Downstream T061 / T062 / T063 / T064 / T065 / T070 / T071 / T102 will read from it; the dependency direction (ADR-006) requires they import only from robinhood_lp.strategy, not the reverse.

The protocol denylist _FORBIDDEN_STRATEGY_ROBINHOOD_MODULES names the currently shipping sibling packages (config, discovery, ingestion, presentation, qualification, quality, replay, rpc, storage). A future sibling added without updating the denylist would silently slip past assert_strategy_layer_is_pure; the dependency walk must be re-validated whenever a new sibling is added.
